faq.title: Jaguar XJ 508PN FAQs
faq.description: Helpful answers on pricing, warranty, specification and fitting for the Jaguar XJ 508PN engine.

faqs.q: How much does a Jaguar XJ 508PN engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your 508PN engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply includes a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for third-party fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 508PN and 508PS?
faqs.a: Both are 5.0-litre V8s from the same family. The 508PN is naturally aspirated, while the 508PS adds a supercharger and produces more power, so one cannot simply replace the other.

faqs.q: Was the 508PN fitted to the 1996 Jaguar XJ?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ used six-cylinder and V12 engines. The 508PN is listed for the X351 XJ from late 2009, so we always confirm your engine code using the VIN.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ 508PN engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant pipe leaks, ignition coil faults and oil leaks. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 508PN to my own garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for outside fitting.

faqs.q: What does your V8 supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Making the Right Decision for Your 508PN V8
workshopIntro.description: Start with a thorough diagnosis. Water pump leaks, coil faults and timing solenoid issues can often be fixed without replacing the engine. If chain failure or overheating has caused internal damage, compare the repair estimate with your XJ's condition, mileage and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ 508PN engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether fitting is included. Removing a V8 from a large saloon involves significant labour, so full supply and fit quotes give the most accurate comparison.

When reviewing 508PN 5.0 V8 petrol engine UK listings, check the donor model, recorded mileage and whether the engine is naturally aspirated. Supercharged units use different parts, so clear answers help you avoid costly mistakes.

Warranty cover is also worth checking. A Jaguar XJ 508PN engine with warranty offers protection if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms before you go ahead.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ 508PN Engine Problems to Check
engineProblems.description: Each symptom may suggest a fault, though only diagnosis can confirm it.

cards.title: Timing Chain Rattle
cards.description: A rattle for a few seconds after starting from cold may relate to worn chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Book a timing inspection before it worsens.

cards.title: Overheating or Coolant Loss
cards.description: Rising temperature, a coolant smell or a dropping reservoir level might indicate a water pump, crossover pipe or thermostat housing leak.
cards.action: Stop driving and request a pressure test.

cards.title: Camshaft Timing Codes
cards.description: An engine warning light with camshaft position or correlation codes could suggest chain stretch or variable timing solenoid faults.
cards.action: Arrange a full diagnostic scan promptly.

cards.title: Uneven Idle or Misfire
cards.description: Shaking at idle or hesitation on acceleration may stem from ignition coils, spark plugs or fuel injector problems.

cards.title: Oil Seeping From Covers
cards.description: Oil around the cam covers or timing covers, or a burning smell, may indicate failing gaskets or seals.
cards.action: Get the leak traced and assessed.

cards.title: Low Oil Pressure Alert
cards.description: An oil pressure warning could relate to low oil level, a sensor fault or internal wear needing immediate investigation.
cards.action: Switch off and check the level.

engineOverview.title: Inside the Naturally Aspirated 5.0 V8 of the XJ
paragraphs: The 508PN is the naturally aspirated version of Jaguar's 5.0-litre AJ133 V8, without the supercharger used on the 508PS. Parts catalogues list it in the X351 XJ with 385PS, or 283kW, sending power to the rear wheels. It uses direct injection and chain-driven camshafts with variable timing.

That 385PS output equals roughly 380hp, so a Jaguar XJ 5.0 V8 petrol engine 375hp listing may be using a rounded or market-specific figure. As outputs and calibrations vary across Jaguar and Land Rover models, we confirm your exact engine from the VIN.

A Jaguar XJ 508PN engine 1996 search won't match either. The XJ of that period used six-cylinder and V12 engines, and the 5.0 V8 arrived much later with the X351. Serious internal damage on this V8 may make replacement more economical than repair.
